name: The head returned

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

summary: Quest 5466 directs the seeker to kill Ras after the mortal transformation, recover his head, and return it to Marduke.
description: Marduke’s instruction is followed by a terrible condition: the mortal Ras must be struck down, and his head brought back. The returned object closes the quest objective; the narration leaves the violence restrained and the result bounded to what the game records. It gives no account of Ras’s spirit afterward, of a lasting freedom from the Scourge, or of other souls departing with him.
